newsitem.title: USA: Crown Cork & Seal holder completes offer.
newsitem.headline: Crown Cork & Seal holder completes offer.

text.p: Crown Cork & Seal Co Inc said on Thursday that its largest shareholder, Compagnie Generale d'Industrie et de Participations (CGIP) sold a portion of its investment in Crown Cork to a group of underwriters led by Lazard Freres & Co LLC, CS First Boston and Salomon Brothers Inc.
The company said CGIP sold 9,250,000 shares of Crown Cork common and three million shares of 4.5 percent convertible preferred stock, for gross proceeds of $560.6 million.
Assuming a 15 percent over-allotment option is exercised, CGIP will own 10.1 percent of Crown Cork's voting power, it said.
Crown Cork said it will not receive any of the proceeds.
